S7 Class for the Predictive Distribution of a New Response

Source: R/predict_objects.R
predictive_type.Rd

This class is the abstract parent of the objects that prediction_interval() takes in its predictive argument: pred_averaged(), pred_plugin() and pred_bootstrap(). A predictive object selects how the estimation uncertainty enters the distribution of a new response.

Usage

predictive_type(label = character(0))

Arguments

label

A short name, printed by print.predictive_type(). The constructor of each subclass sets it, since the class itself cannot be built.

Value

Nothing: the class is abstract and the constructor signals an error. Used as a class object it has one property, label, which every subclass inherits.

Details

The class is abstract and cannot be instantiated. Calling predictive_type() signals an error. The three shipped distributions are compared in predictive_distributions.

See also

predictive_distributions for the three side by side, prediction_interval() for the consumer.

Examples

S7::S7_inherits(pred_averaged(), predictive_type)
#> [1] TRUE
S7::S7_inherits(pred_bootstrap(n = 50), predictive_type)
#> [1] TRUE
try(predictive_type("my own"))
#> Error in S7::new_object(S7::S7_object(), label = label) : 
#>   Can't construct an object from abstract class <predictive_type>
